CustomField.description: Summarizes the current confirmed stock balance.
CustomField.formula: IF(Confirmed_On_Hand__c < 0, "Check Balance", IF(Posted_Receipts__c = 0, "Awaiting Stock", IF(Confirmed_On_Hand__c = 0, "Depleted", "In Stock")))
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Investigate a Check Balance result before making further postings.
CustomField.label: Stock State
